parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented border friction, no bathroom/facility exclusion, no police sweeps or state threat-framing: nothing reaches the tier-1/tier-2 exposures that anchor 0.35–0.45. The worst documented feature is tier 3 — real hostility with essentially no recourse. Police dismiss a trans woman's assault complaints because her ID marker reads male ('violence between two men'), producing documented impunity; health care is a flagged setting for being turned away or poorly served; a 2024 broadcaster report puts trans assault risk above four times baseline (basis unverified — weak, directional only). Against that: lengthy-registration-only organising, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, and a national pattern of social invisibility rather than open persecution, with a dated 2015 account of little violence. No protections are documented as operating for visitors, so the jurisdiction sits below the remedy-working 0.55 tier.
